protocol.full: image in RAM -> reflect/letterbox/R0 -> P -> fixed prediction-only PnP
protocol.P_only: feature capture to refined candidate serialization, including conditioning and preservation checks
protocol.isolation: shared R0 and one N3 head resident; same-session R0/N3 timing; not isolated per-arm memory
protocol.seed_policy: fixed historical runtime seed1 only, no accuracy selection; accuracy tables use three-seed means
